summary.text: Harvey Epstein represents the 2nd District on the New York City Council, which includes Greenwich Village, the Lower East Side, the East Village, Gramercy and Murray Hill-Kips Bay.
His Council biography says he previously served as Assembly Member for District 74 from 2018.

paragraphs.text: Epstein has been a community leader for almost 30 years, according to his Council biography, and earlier worked with The Legal Aid Society and the Urban Justice Center.
Before joining the Assembly in 2018 he served 14 years on Community Board 3, including as board chair, and as a public school parent he was president of the District 1 President's Council.
He was a tenant member of the Rent Guidelines Board for five years, during which the board approved its first one-year lease rent freeze.
The biography says he passed over 50 bills into law in the Assembly, including legislation on tenant protections, affordable housing, early voting and funding for schools and transit.
